Selected Work

Selected work in behavioral science, organizational research, quantitative methods, and workplace decision-making.

Behavioral science · Workplace solidarity

When Workplace Solidarity Breaks Down

Five-study research program examining how race and gender shape perceived solidarity, support, and reactions to workplace equality initiatives.

Policy perceptions · Organizational credibility

How DEI Backtracking Harms Trust

Multi-study project testing how people distinguish symbolic from substantive DEI action and how organizational reversals shape trust and credibility.

Belief change · Group interaction

When Dialogue Does Not Persuade Symmetrically

Online group-conversation experiment showing that exposure to opposing views can shift attitudes differently across audience segments.

Longitudinal analysis · Methods

Mapping Daily Mind Wandering with Experience Sampling

A repeated-measures methods project showing how daily data can separate within-person dynamics from between-person differences.
